variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: A political party has split in two in {colony}. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: The colony has seen a party divide into two organisations. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: A split has divided a political party in the colony. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
